name._instruction: Add canonical name of this fluorescent calcium indicator.

chemicalComposition._instruction: Add the underlying molecular composition of the indicator.

emissionPeak._instruction: Add peak emission wavelength of the indicator, expressed in nanometers.

onKinetics._instruction: Add rise time (on-kinetics) of fluorescence after calcium binding, typically in milliseconds.

offKinetics._instruction: Add decay time (off-kinetics) of fluorescence after calcium unbinding, typically in milliseconds.

apparentDissociationConstant._instruction: Add apparent dissociation constant (binding affinity for Ca²⁺), typically in micromolar (µM).
